response.sql: WITH hof_with_players AS (SELECT h.player_id, p.death_state FROM hall_of_fame h INNER JOIN player p ON h.player_id = p.player_id), state_counts AS (SELECT death_state, COUNT(*) AS state_count FROM hof_with_players GROUP BY death_state), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(state_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts), filtered_states AS (SELECT state_count, (SELECT avg_count FROM overall_avg) AS overall_average FROM state_counts WHERE state_count > (SELECT avg_count FROM overall_avg)) SELECT AVG(state_count) AS average_count, AVG(state_count - overall_average) AS average_excess FROM filtered_states
